items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: that valet, Rudolph, he'd take him in there

ctx.x: But you see, what he had, see we had three valets. Now, one was just to take care of him, see, and this valet, see, he'd be hanging, drunk, and that valet, Rudolph, he'd take him in there and put him in the shower, cold shower, And then, he'd go out there and shake his head on "Minnie the Moocher" And every now and then he'd feel dizzy and he'd run to the wing, and Rudolph would stick that ammonia on a stick, stick it under his nose, you know, and that would straighten him up again.
